summary: India's GEO / AI-visibility agency market is crowded with SEO and full-service agencies bolting GEO onto old offers, and almost none of them publish AI-citation results. Rankings are self-published (Pepper and Texta each rank themselves first). Buyers are being told to demand proof of real AI citations, sector fit and execution, and to run a 3-month pilot. That gap, plus Iterate's operator-led pods and its five-layer model (discovery through community), is the opening: be the agency that shows citations, not traffic, and that executes beyond search.
